title: Quavo Confirms Final Migos Album & Tour With Offset Is in the Works: ‘We Going to Do It Right’
summary: "We want to make sure we honor him," he added of late cousin and groupmate Takeoff.
contentText:
The Migos are back! Quavo confirmed plans for a final Migos album and a subsequent tour reuniting with Offset.

Huncho briefly spoke about the Migos LP, which will serve as the group’s first since 2021’s Culture III , which debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 .

When the project does arrive, it will also be the first without groupmate Takeoff, who was shot and killed on Nov. 1, 2022, in Houston. However, expect Take’s vocals to posthumously appear on the album.

“We coming back. We’re going to do it one more time,” Quavo said in an interview with V-103’s DJ Greg Street earlier in September. “Long live the Rocket … There’s more. We going to tour. We going to do it right.”

Quavo shed more light on a Migos album during an interview on Hot 97 with Nessa, which was posted on Thursday (Sept. 10).

“At the same time, we missing the Rocket, so we want to make sure we honor him and make sure we have the right tools to make the music sound original as if he was here,” he explained.

Huncho wants to make sure he properly honors the legacy of his late nephew, and he doesn’t think TakeOff would want him to withhold music from fans.

“We owe the fans at least the music. What he was working on and what we still had. The legacy must still go on,” he added. “I don’t think he would want us to archive no music, being that I know somebody out here that’s listening to every word Take saying and moving off his lyrics.”

Quavo is also preparing for the release of his third solo album. Qrömelife is set to hit streaming services on Oct. 2. It’s the Atlanta native’s first solo project since 2023’s Rocket Power, which debuted at No. 18 on the Billboard 200.

Entirely produced by Pharrell, Huncho added to the 14-track LP’s rollout on Friday (Sept. 11) when joining forces with fellow ATLien T.I. for their “Backwards” single.
